The Medicaid Improvement and State Flexibility Act of 2025 (H.R. 936) empowers states to innovate beyond bloated bureaucracy - allowing patients to choose electronic benefit cards for primary care while maintaining catastrophic coverage. Federal spending remains capped at pre-reform levels, forcing efficiency rather than cuts.

Nevada's 42% Medicaid enrollment surge since 2014 proves the old model incentivized dependency over sustainability. The real issue? Previous administrations ballooned enrollment without structural reforms, creating a fiscal time bomb.

This legislation stops the bleeding by putting patients in control instead of hospital administrators lobbying for perpetual funding increases.
